title: Central: a PowerShell session crashed with 0xC0000005 in AmsiUtils.WinUninitialize during shutdown, after a read-only command
outcome: Central: a PowerShell session crashed with 0xC0000005 in AmsiUtils.WinUninitialize during shutdown, after a read-only command
